colony(hasColony==False)->a colony [PAWN_pronoun] no longer names
comrade(hasComrade==True)->Among your people [PAWN_pronoun] recognised [COMRADE_nameDef], who had once lived in [colony] too.
comrade(hasComrade==False)->
childhood(grownUp==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] was only a child back then; [YEARS] have passed since.

r_story->[leave] [childhood] [journey] [disaster] [aftermath] [arrival] [comrade]
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] told you that one day [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave [colony] and see the stars.
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] said that life in [colony] had grown too small, so one spring [PAWN_pronoun] simply left.
journey->[PAWN_pronoun] found a crew of spacers and travelled with them, opening one new world after another.
journey->[PAWN_pronoun] signed on to a battered freighter and saw planets [PAWN_pronoun] had only heard of in stories.
disaster(hasFaction==True)->But the ship was boarded by [FACTION_name], and [PAWN_nameDef] had to abandon it in a transport pod.
disaster(hasFaction==True)->Then [FACTION_name] caught the ship near a dead moon; [PAWN_nameDef] was the only one to reach the pods.
disaster(hasFaction==False)->But pirates boarded the ship, and [PAWN_nameDef] had to abandon it in a transport pod.
aftermath(scars==True)->The pod came down burning, and the scars of that landing are still on [PAWN_possessive] body.
aftermath(scars==False)->The pod came down hard, far from anywhere.
arrival->After days of wandering, [PAWN_pronoun] came to you.
arrival->[PAWN_pronoun] walked for many days before seeing the smoke of your colony.
r_story->[leave] [childhood] [road] [end] [arrival] [comrade]
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] told you that after [colony] [PAWN_pronoun] could not sit in one place anymore.
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] said [PAWN_pronoun] left [colony] with nothing but a pack and a rifle.
road(hasFaction==True)->For years [PAWN_pronoun] walked with the caravans of [FACTION_name], guarding their goods and learning their songs.
road(hasFaction==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] found work among [FACTION_name] and travelled with their traders from town to town.
road(hasFaction==False)->For years [PAWN_pronoun] walked with passing caravans, guarding their goods and learning their songs.
end->One winter the caravan broke up, and everyone went their own way.
end->In the end [PAWN_pronoun] grew tired of roads that never led home.
arrival->Rumours of a young colony brought [PAWN_objective] to your door.
arrival->[PAWN_pronoun] hopes your colony will be the last stop.
r_story->[leave] [childhood] [capture] [escape] [arrival] [comrade]
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] told you that [PAWN_pronoun] left [colony] to look for a better place.
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] said [PAWN_pronoun] parted with [colony] on good terms and set off alone.
capture(hasFaction==True)->On the road [PAWN_pronoun] was taken by [FACTION_name] and spent a long time in their cages.
capture(hasFaction==False)->On the road [PAWN_pronoun] was taken by pirates and spent a long time in their cages.
escape(scars==True)->One night [PAWN_pronoun] broke free, leaving a lot of blood behind; the scars have stayed, and so has the fear.
escape(scars==False)->One night [PAWN_pronoun] slipped out while the guards were drunk.
arrival->[PAWN_pronoun] has been running ever since, and your colony is the first place where [PAWN_pronoun] dares to stop.
r_story->[leave] [childhood] [wilds] [beast] [arrival] [comrade]
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] told you that [PAWN_pronoun] left [colony] to live off the land, far from people.
wilds->For a long time [PAWN_pronoun] hunted, foraged and talked only to the wind.
beast(scars==True)->Then a starving pack found [PAWN_possessive] camp; [PAWN_pronoun] survived, but the marks of their teeth remain.
beast(scars==False)->Then a hard winter came, and the land had nothing left to give.
arrival->Following the smell of cooking fires, [PAWN_pronoun] found your colony.
r_story->[past] [now] [comrade]
past(hasFaction==True)->After [colony] [PAWN_nameDef] spent years on the road, trading with [FACTION_name].
past(hasFaction==False)->After [colony] [PAWN_nameDef] spent years on the road, trading wherever [PAWN_pronoun] could.
now(hasHome==True)->Now [PAWN_pronoun] travels with [HOME_name] and is glad to see a friendly settlement.
now(hasHome==False)->Now [PAWN_pronoun] travels alone and is glad to see a friendly settlement.
r_story->[past] [now] [comrade]
past->[PAWN_nameDef] says [PAWN_pronoun] still dreams of [colony] sometimes.
now(hasHome==True)->These days [PAWN_pronoun] lives among [HOME_name] and has found a quiet sort of peace there.
now(hasHome==False)->These days [PAWN_pronoun] has found a quiet sort of peace.
r_story->[fall] [now]
fall->Word is that [colony] fell, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the few who walked away.
now(hasHome==True)->Hunger brought [PAWN_objective] to [HOME_name], and [PAWN_pronoun] no longer asks whose home [PAWN_pronoun] burns.
now(hasHome==False)->Hunger taught [PAWN_objective] to take what others have.
r_story->[raid] [wounds] [now]
raid(hasFaction==True)->When [FACTION_name] burned [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] fought until the last wall fell.
raid(hasFaction==False)->When raiders burned [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] fought until the last wall fell.
wounds(scars==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] carries the bullet scars of that day, and something in [PAWN_objective] learned to love the fight.
wounds(scars==False)->Something in [PAWN_objective] learned to love the fight that day.
now->Now [PAWN_pronoun] raids others the way [PAWN_pronoun] was once raided.
r_story->[taken] [marks]
taken(hasFaction==True)->[PAWN_nameDef] was taken by [FACTION_name] not long after leaving [colony] and has been sold from hand to hand ever since.
taken(hasFaction==False)->[PAWN_nameDef] was taken by slavers not long after leaving [colony] and has been sold from hand to hand ever since.
marks(scars==True)->The whip has left its marks.
marks(scars==False)->[PAWN_pronoun] keeps [PAWN_possessive] eyes down and says little.
r_story->[ask] [answer] [detail]
ask->When asked where [PAWN_pronoun] has been, [PAWN_nameDef] only looks at [PAWN_possessive] hands.
ask->[PAWN_nameDef] does not talk about [colony], or about how it ended.
answer->"It was dark. Then it was not," is all [PAWN_pronoun] says.
answer->"Someone called my name," [PAWN_pronoun] says, and will not say who.
detail(scars==True)->The old wounds have closed into pale scars, as if years had passed for [PAWN_objective] in a single night.
detail(scars==False)->[PAWN_pronoun] sleeps with the lights on.
r_story->[sign]
sign->[PAWN_pronoun] still wears what looks like the colours of [colony].
sign->For a moment [PAWN_pronoun] seems to look straight at you, as if trying to remember.
